_note: US/UK word pairs for the 'US or UK?' series (gen.py --plan). Curated by an English teacher: same meaning, everyday American word vs everyday British word, one word each (the card and the word clock need single tokens). example = a short A2 American sentence using the US word in THIS sense (the bank example can be another sense: line, check). Facts gate: both words + IPA must be in the audited word bank (qc.py shows / checks those IPA cells); pairs missing from the bank are skipped until the bank has them.
